lines.en: label chikaspring5:
scene noonsky
Ahh, the afternoon — that magical time sandwiched between day and night.
lines.zh: 啊，午后——夹在白昼与夜晚之间的那段神奇时光。

lines.en: Not as magical as “noon” itself as that only lasts for sixty seconds, but magical nonetheless.
lines.zh: 当然没有「正午」本身那么神奇——毕竟那只有六十秒——但依然神奇。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath1
Which is further evidenced by these two naked girls in a bathtub! Just one of them is having a much easier time than the other for reasons you’re already well aware of.
lines.zh: 这一点从浴缸里这两个裸体女孩身上就能进一步印证！只是其中一个比另一个自在得多，原因你心里清楚。

lines.en: : Are you just going to sit there and blush the entire time?
lines.zh: : 你就打算一直坐在那儿脸红吗？

lines.en: : That’s the plan, yeah.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这么打算的。

lines.en: : Weird. I figured you’d be more open to looking at me naked after what happened in your room the other night.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我以为那天晚上在你房间发生了那事之后，你看我裸体应该更放得开才对。

lines.en: : In my defense, you had your clothes on back then. And I was also not in the strongest state of mind after being yelled at by my mom for trying to fuck your boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 替我自己说一句，那时候你可是穿着衣服的。而且我因为想睡你男朋友被我妈骂了一顿，精神状态本来也不太稳。

lines.en: : Want me to rub your shoulders?
lines.zh: : 要我帮你揉揉肩吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath2
: Don’t touch me. I’ll cum.
lines.zh: : 别碰我。我会高潮的。

lines.en: : Just relax, okay? I’m not gonna touch you, especially when Chinami is right outside the bathroom. Just think of it like being in the shower at school or the dorms.
lines.zh: : 放松点，好吗？我不会碰你的，尤其 Chinami 就在浴室外面。你就当是在学校或宿舍的淋浴间好了。

lines.en: : Those are way less...intimate, though. In here, it’s just you and me. Which, up until recently, would have probably been okay? But now, I’m...well...you know. There’s...history and stuff.
lines.zh: : 可那些地方没这么……私密啊。这儿就只有你和我。要是在不久以前，这大概也没什么？但现在，我……嗯……你知道的。我们之间……有了历史和那些事。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath3
: You’re not going to feel weird around me forever now, are you? I was just trying to help you feel better.
lines.zh: : 你不会从今往后在我身边都觉得别扭吧？我只是想让你好受一点。

lines.en: : N-No! It won’t be forever! Just...probably for the immediate future since there’s still a lot I’m...confused about when it comes to you.
lines.zh: : 不——不会！不会是永远！只是……大概在最近的将来会，因为关于你，我还有很多……搞不明白的地方。

lines.en: : Like what? Can I, like...help clear anything up? Or...
lines.zh: : 比如什么？我能……帮你理清楚什么吗？或者……

lines.en: : I, uhh...
: You...
: You still...love Sensei...right?
lines.zh: : 你还……爱着 Sensei……对吧？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath4
: Yeah. With all of my heart.
lines.zh: : 嗯。用我的整颗心。

lines.en: : Buuuut...you’re okay with...hooking up with other people now?
lines.zh: : 但——是……你现在不介意……跟别人搞在一起了？

lines.en: : Not anybody. Just you. You’re the only person I’ve ever done anything with apart from Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不是任何人。只有你。除了 Sensei，你是我唯一与之做过什么的人。

lines.en: : Okay, but...
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……

lines.en: : Would you have ever done that to...err...with me if you hadn’t found out he’d been hooking up with other people?
lines.zh: : 要是你没发现他一直跟别人乱搞，你会对我……呃……跟我做那种事吗？

lines.en: : Probably not, no.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath5
: See?! That’s why I’m freaking out! The Chika I know wouldn’t ever do anything like that!
lines.zh: : 你看！？这就是我抓狂的原因！我认识的那个 Chika 绝不会做这种事！

lines.en: : People change, Rin. I’m not the same girl I used to be. I’m smarter now.
lines.zh: : 人是会变的，Rin。我不再是以前那个女孩了。我现在更聪明了。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath6
: But are you “smarter” because you want to be? Or because you have to be?
lines.zh: : 可你是「因为想变」而聪明了？还是「因为不得不」才变聪明的？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath7
: I just...you...you’re only the second person I’ve ever done stuff with. And if that was just because you were doing it to, like...get back at Sensei or something...I’m going to feel really shitty.
lines.zh: : 我只是……你……你只是我第二个与之做过那种事的人。如果那只是因为你为了……比如说报复 Sensei 才这么做……我会觉得很难受。

lines.en: : It’s not like that at all, Rin. I promise.
lines.zh: : 完全不是那样，Rin。我保证。

lines.en: : Don’t promise me things like that because I’m just going to get hung up on it. You know how I am.
lines.zh: : 别跟我保证这种事，因为我会一直纠结的。你知道我什么样。

lines.en: : I do know how you are, which is why I’d never try and use you for something petty like that.
lines.zh: : 我确实知道你什么样，所以我绝不会为了那种小心眼的事利用你。

lines.en: : So...you wouldn’t do that to try and push me one way or the other?
lines.zh: : 所以……你不会为了把我推向某一边才那么做？

lines.en: : Because another thought I had was that...you were kind of just...trying to pull me closer to you so I’d stop thinking about Sensei so much.
lines.zh: : 因为我还想过一种可能……你有点像是在……把我拉得离你更近，好让我别再老是想着 Sensei。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath8
: Is that...wrong?
lines.zh: : 那……不对吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...and it really hurts to hear you say that.
lines.zh: : 对……听你这么说真的很伤人。

lines.en: : But you see how it must look from my point of view, right?! I followed you for years and nothing happened! But then the second I like your boyfriend, you suddenly want to hook up with me?
lines.zh: : 可你明白从我的角度看这像什么吧？！我追了你那么多年，什么都没发生！结果我一喜欢上你男朋友，你突然就想跟我搞在一起了？

lines.en: : I just wanted to-
lines.zh: : 我只是想——

lines.en: : I know you...said you just wanted to make me feel better. I know. But...doing that kind of stuff with other people, like...means something to me, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我知道你……说过你只是想让我好受一点。我知道。可是……跟别人做那种事，对我来说……是有意义的，Chika。

lines.en: : It means something to me too. That’s why I did it.
lines.zh: : 对我来说也有意义。所以我才那么做。

lines.en: : But the timing is just...so...off. And you’ve already been getting kind of crazy lately. So in my head it was all just, “does she even realize what she’s doing right now?”
lines.zh: : 可这个时机就是……太……不对了。而且你最近本来就有点疯。所以在我脑子里就一直转着一句话：「她到底知不知道自己现在在做什么？」

lines.en: : You keep saying that. Everybody’s saying that. How am I crazy? Just because I don’t look at things the same way as you? Is that it?
lines.zh: : 你老这么说。所有人都这么说。我哪里疯了？就因为我看事情的角度跟你不一样？就因为这个？

lines.en: : Chika, do you have any idea just how many times you vented to me about being terrified that Sensei was seeing someone else?
lines.zh: : Chika，你知不知道你跟我倒过多少次苦水，说你害怕 Sensei 在跟别人交往？

lines.en: : Probably...a lot...I imagine.
lines.zh: : 大概……很多次吧……我想。

lines.en: : And now you’re just fine with it? What happened to loyalty? What happened to being his and only his?
lines.zh: : 现在你就这么接受了？忠诚去哪了？「只属于他」去哪了？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath9
: That’s not...how love works.
lines.zh: : 那不是……爱运作的方式。

lines.en: : No, that’s not how love works for him. So it feels like you’re just changing your definition of that to adapt and...I don’t know...protect yourself? Does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 不，那不是「他」的爱运作的方式。所以感觉就像是你只是在改变自己对爱的定义，好去适应，还有……我不知道……保护自己？这说得通吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Chika. I know this isn’t the time or place, but...
lines.zh: : 对不起，Chika。我知道现在不是时候、也不是地方，可是……

lines.en: : I’m really worried about you. And if you’re not okay, you can just talk to me. You don’t have to...you know...
lines.zh: : 我真的很担心你。要是你不好，直接跟我说就行。你不必……你知道的……

lines.en: : How long...have you known about him, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你……知道他的事多久了，Rin？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : When I told you he was seeing other people, you didn’t seem surprised at all.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你他在跟别人交往的时候，你看起来一点也不意外。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath10
: How long have you known?
lines.zh: : 你知道多久了？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath11
: Do you think it was right of you to hide that? To just keep your mouth shut while I vent to you about fearing something you know is happening?
lines.zh: : 你觉得瞒着我是对的吗？我跟你倾诉我害怕的事，而你明知那正在发生，却只是闭着嘴？

lines.en: : No...I don’t think it was right. But I-
lines.zh: : 不……我不觉得那是对的。但我——

lines.en: : You did it because you wanted to protect me. You didn’t want to see me hurt.
lines.zh: : 你那么做是因为想保护我。你不想看到我受伤。

lines.en: : And...you’re not mad about that?
lines.zh: : 而……你不为这个生气吗？

lines.en: : Of course I’m mad. I could drown you right now.
lines.zh: : 我当然生气。我现在就能把你淹死。

lines.en: : Please don’t. I want to die with my clothes on.
lines.zh: : 别这样。我想穿着衣服死。

lines.en: : I don’t intend to. You already told me you’d cum if I touched you and it’d be really degrading to watch you orgasm right before dying.
lines.zh: : 我没打算这么做。你说过我一碰你就会高潮，而看着你在死前高潮，实在太丢人了。

lines.en: : I feel like it would be kind of fitting, though. It makes sense that I’d go out like that.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得那样倒挺合适的。我就该是这么走的。

lines.en: : Well, you’re not going to go out at all. I’m keeping you here forever.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你哪儿也去不了。我要把你永远留在这儿。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath12
: You’re taking me hostage?! See?! I knew you were going crazy!
lines.zh: : 你要绑架我？！看吧？！我就知道你疯了！

lines.en: scene chikarinbath13
: No, I’m keeping you with me forever. How could I ever throw away someone who’d go through so much for my sake?
lines.zh: : 不，我是要你永远陪着我。我怎么可能扔掉一个为了我付出这么多的人？

lines.en: : I know you hate keeping secrets and I know how hard you must have worked to hide all of that from me. And I’m sure it’s the same for Sensei too since I know you care about him.
lines.zh: : 我知道你讨厌保守秘密，也知道你为了对我隐瞒这些费了多大劲。而 Sensei 那边肯定也一样，因为我知道你在乎他。

lines.en: : And maybe you’re right. Maybe I...am going out of my way to try and rewrite my thoughts on “love” to try and protect myself. I’m not saying it isn’t possible.
lines.zh: : 也许你是对的。也许我……确实在刻意重写自己对「爱」的看法，好保护自己。我不是说这不可能。

lines.en: : Well, what are you saying then? Because I still don’t get it. How can you go from being so loyal and so focused on him to pushing me down on the bed and making me cum my brains out?
lines.zh: : 那你到底想说什么？因为我还是不明白。你怎么能从那么忠诚、那么一心扑在他身上，变成把我按在床上、让我爽到脑子都出来了？

lines.en: : I told you the other night. Because I love you.
lines.zh: : 那天晚上我说过了。因为我爱你。

lines.en: : But you love me as a friend. Sensei’s the one you actually love.
lines.zh: : 可你爱我只是朋友那种。Sensei 才是你真正爱的人。

lines.en: : Maybe. But that still doesn’t change the fact that I wanted to do what I did that night. I wasn’t just using you. I could never.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。但那依然改变不了那一晚我想那么做的事实。我不是在利用你。我永远都不会。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Hold on. If you wanted to do that and weren’t just confused or trying to push me in one direction, it would mean-
lines.zh: : 等等。如果你那么做是出于自愿，而不是困惑、也不是想把我推到某一边，那就意味着——

lines.en: : Don’t...try and figure it out. It’s confusing and weird and...uncharacteristic,  sure. But we don’t need to come up with some clear-cut definition of what that was. It just...was.
lines.zh: : 别……别试图弄明白。那很混乱、很奇怪，而且……确实不像我会做的事。但我们不需要给那件事下个非黑即白的定义。它只是……发生了。

lines.en: : If you and Yumi both think I’m going insane, there’s clearly some merit to it. You guys know me better than anybody. But then, that begs the question — if it’s keeping me happy...what’s the problem?
lines.zh: : 如果你和 Yumi 都觉得我疯了，那显然有点道理。你们比我更了解我自己。但这就引出一个问题——如果这让我快乐……那有什么问题？

lines.en: : Are you happy, Chika? Or are you just pretending to be because you’re afraid of everything falling apart?
lines.zh: : 你快乐吗，Chika？还是只是因为害怕一切崩塌，才假装快乐？

lines.en: : You’ve already lost so much. No one would hold it against you for trying to keep yourself from losing Sensei too.
lines.zh: : 你已经失去了这么多。没人会因为你不想连 Sensei 也失去而责怪你。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath14
: I won’t lose Sensei...I’m winning.
lines.zh: : 我不会失去 Sensei……我正赢着呢。

lines.en: : Winning what? Him?
lines.zh: : 赢什么？赢他？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: He loves me most of all.
lines.zh: : 他最爱的是我。

lines.en: : Chika...
lines.zh: : Chika……

lines.en: : What will happen if you find out he doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 要是你发现他不是呢，会怎么样？

lines.en: : If you know something about that, please just keep your mouth shut and don’t risk making me feel even worse. Okay?
lines.zh: : 要是你知道什么，拜托闭嘴，别冒险让我更难受。好吗？

lines.en: : I don’t...know anything about who he loves the most. But I hope for your sake that it is you. If you’re actually fine with that and aren’t just pretending, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道他最爱谁。但为了你，我希望是你。我是说，如果你真的能接受，而不是在假装的话。

lines.en: : Can you look at me for a second?
lines.zh: : 你能看我一下吗？

lines.en: : Hold on...I’m trying not to start crying.
lines.zh: : 等等……我在努力不让自己哭出来。

lines.en: : You can cry if you want. It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 想哭就哭吧。没关系的。

lines.en: : Just...hold on. Okay?
lines.zh: : 就……等等。好吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath15
: Okay. Hi.
lines.zh: : 好。嗨。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : Do we, like...kiss now? How does this work?
lines.zh: : 我们……那个……现在要接吻吗？这该怎么弄？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Like, I want to. But it still feels weird.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。就是，我是想。但还是觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Yeah, same.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也是。

lines.en: : So you, like...like really want to do stuff like that with me then? It’s not all just...for my sake?
lines.zh: : 所以你……是真的想跟我做那种事？不全是为了我好？

lines.en: : Rin, do you really think I have been flirting and trying to dress you up in cute outfits for so long just because we’re really good friends?
: You...You’ve  been trying to seduce me this whole time?!
scene chikarinbath16
: I don’t know if I’d say seduce.
lines.zh: : 我不知道能不能叫勾引。

lines.en: : But I’d definitely be lying if I said I didn’t occasionally imagine the two of us making out in my bed sometimes.
: I need to get out of the bath now.
lines.zh: : 我得从浴缸里出来了。

lines.en: : Yes. I also need to do that.
lines.zh: : 对。我也得出去了。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath17
: Chinami! How would you feel if big sis Chika started dating girls instead of boys?!
lines.zh: : Chinami！要是 Chika 姐姐开始跟女生交往而不是男生，你会怎么想？！

lines.en: : Are we really going to drag her into this now?
lines.zh: : 我们真要把她也扯进来吗？

lines.en: : Chinami wouldn’t care! But she’d be confused if it was big sis Yumi because that would make our family like the Lannisters!
: Also, she’s worried about what would happen to Papa!
lines.zh: : 还有，她担心 Papa 会怎么样！

lines.en: scene chikarinbath18
: I just wanted to see what she’d say.
lines.zh: : 我只是想看看她会说什么。

lines.en: : Does she really call Sensei “Papa?”
lines.zh: : 她真管 Sensei 叫「爸爸」吗？

lines.en: : Of course. He’s the closest thing to a dad she’s ever had.
lines.zh: : 当然。他是她这辈子有过的最接近爸爸的人。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath19
: Which...adds one more reason you’re so afraid of losing him. Two hearts would be breaking instead of just one.
lines.zh: : 那……又多了一个你那么怕失去他的理由。会碎的是两颗心，而不是一颗。

lines.en: : Mhm! But we don’t have to worry about that since he’s never going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 嗯！不过我们不用担心，因为他永远都不会走。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath20
: Yeah...things will work out for you. They’ve got to eventually.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你的事会有好结果的。总有一天会的。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath21
: I guess you did manage to score this apartment, though. This place seems really nice for what you’re paying for it.
: Right? I have no idea how the Tsukiokas make so much money with rent prices like these.
lines.zh: : 对吧？我真不知道 Tsukioka 家靠这种房租怎么能赚那么多钱。

lines.en: : Again...it’s gotta be the fucking bubble wrap. I chose the wrong line of work.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍……肯定是他妈的泡泡纸。我入错行了。

lines.en: : No cursing in front of Chinami. Remember?
lines.zh: : 在 Chinami 面前不许说脏话。记得吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath22
: Oh, shit. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。抱歉。

lines.en: : Rin. Please.
lines.zh: : Rin。拜托。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath23
: Oh, fuck! I did it again!
lines.zh: : 哦，操！我又说了一次！

lines.en: : Am I going to need to ban you from my apartment?
lines.zh: : 我是不是得禁止你进我家了？

lines.en: : Probably! How the f...frog does Yumi manage to control herself here?!
lines.zh: : 大概是！Yumi 到底是怎……怎么他「蛙」的在这儿忍住的？！

lines.en: : Yumi froggin’ loves Chinami and wishes only the froggin’ best for her! That’s how!
lines.zh: : Yumi 他「蛙」的爱 Chinami，只希望她得到他「蛙」的最好的一切！就是这样！

lines.en: : Did you just accidentally corrupt my little sister?
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是不小心把我妹带坏了？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath24
: I’m sorry. You can’t take me anywhere without me ruining everything. Just ban me now.
lines.zh: : 对不起。你带我去哪儿我都会把一切搞砸。现在就禁了我吧。

lines.en: : You know, if you moved into one of the vacant rooms, I could ban you and we could still hang out here. Then, I wouldn’t ever really need to go back to the dorms either.
scene chikarinbath25
: Move in? There are still empty rooms here?
lines.zh: : 搬进来？这儿还有空房间？

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think all of them are listed yet. You can afford it after your raise, can’t you? Even more so if you bring Futaba along and add in what she gets from her parents.
: Futaba’s parents stopped sending her money a while ago.
lines.zh: : Futaba 的父母前阵子不再给她寄钱了。

lines.en: scene chikarinbath26
: What? They’re not still, like...MIA right?
lines.zh: : 什么？他们不会还是……失联状态吧？

lines.en: : She doesn’t seem as worried as she was in the beginning, but...yeah. She hasn’t heard from them in a while.
lines.zh: : 她看起来没一开始那么担心了，不过……是啊。她有一阵子没收到他们的消息了。

lines.en: : Oh my God. I hope they’re okay. And not just because I want you guys to live here too. Futaba is a sweetheart and deserves only the best.
scene chikarinbath27
: She’d never try to steal Chinami’s papa. Right, Rin?
lines.zh: : 她绝不会想抢走 Chinami 的爸爸。对吧，Rin？

lines.en: : What’s Chinami hearing about somebody trying to steal her papa?! Chinami will froggin’ kill them!
lines.zh: : Chinami 听到什么了？有人想抢她的爸爸？！Chinami 要他「蛙」的杀了他们！

lines.en: : Chinami better stop using “frog” as a replacement for bad words or big sis Chika is going to take her games awaaaay!
scene chikarinbath28
: One day, Chinami will have justice!
lines.zh: : 总有一天，Chinami 会讨回公道的！

lines.en: : Chika...about...what you just said...
lines.zh: : Chika……关于……你刚才说的……

lines.en: : Should I text Sensei and tell him to come over? This complex is technically for women only, but Touka would definitely bend the rules if it’s for him, right?
scene chikarinbath29
: Here?! Now?! Us?! Together?! Pajamas?!
lines.zh: : 这儿？！现在？！我们？！一起？！睡衣？！

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Rin? You’re not nervous around him now, are you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Rin？你现在在他面前不紧张了吧？

lines.en: : I am nervous around everyone. It’s part of my nature.
lines.zh: : 我在谁面前都紧张。这是我的天性。

lines.en: : Theeeeeen should I press send?
lines.zh: : 那————我要按发送了哦？

lines.en: scene chikarinbath30
: I don’t even know what you wrote yet. Let me-
lines.zh: : 我都还不知道你写了什么。让我——

lines.en: scene chikarinbath31
: Western silverback...
lines.zh: : 西部银背大猩猩……

lines.en: scene noonsky
: I’m gonna do it. Here goes-
lines.zh: : 我要发了。开始了——

lines.en: : Don’t you dare!
lines.zh: : 你敢！

lines.en: : Aah! Chinami! Your sister is under attack! Help!
lines.zh: : 啊！Chinami！你姐姐被袭击了！救命！

lines.en: : Hey! Get your froggin’ hands off of big sis Chika!
lines.zh: : 嘿！把你他「蛙」的手从 Chika 姐姐身上拿开！

lines.en: : Chinami is grounded now!
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在被禁足了！

lines.en: : For helping?!
lines.zh: : 就因为帮忙？！

lines.en: : Chika! Give me the phooooone!
lines.zh: : Chika！把手————机还给我！

lines.en: : Neveeeeeeer!
scene black
$ chikaspring5 = True
Rin manages to secure the phone and backspaces the message before Chika ever sends it, but surely that doesn’t stop them from thinking about it.
lines.zh: Rin 总算抢到了手机，在 Chika 发出去之前把消息删掉了——但这肯定拦不住她们去想那件事。

lines.en: Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: Surely, he remains the centerpiece of their fantasies.
lines.zh: 想必，他依然是她们幻想的核心。

lines.zh: 对吧？
